title: A TAKEOVER PAYS NO FREE STRONGHOLD OR GOLDEN HOARD
why: When the host window closes or loses its link, player 2 picks up the raid. The bodies his window only mirrored from the host are let go then (only the Overseer is rebuilt), and that includes a stronghold garrison and, often, the golden enemy (the golden pick is a garrison body in about a third of raids). The raid then ran on his window: an open stronghold found no defender alive and paid STRONGHOLD CLEARED, 1,000, for a garrison nobody fought, and the golden enemy, gone from the list, was taken as killed and dropped a free golden hoard with GOLDEN ENEMY DOWN. Proven in headless Chromium: host breached the gate with 11 defenders alive, player 2 took the world word with mirrored bodies, the host dropped, and three ticks later player 2 had STRONGHOLD CLEARED +1,000 and GOLDEN ENEMY DOWN with one hoard. A stronghold with no defender known to the window is not taken as cleared, and a golden enemy that was a mirror let go at the takeover is not taken as killed.
now: When player 2 picks up the raid after the host drops, he is no longer paid a stronghold clear or a golden hoard nobody earned.
